# Vendored Plotly.js

The dashboard uses the Plotly.js cartesian bundle from
`plotly.js-cartesian-dist-min` **2.35.2**, pinned locally in
`plotly-cartesian-2.35.2.min.js`. This exact version supports the dashboard's
scatter, bar, and heatmap charts. The app does not load Plotly from a runtime
CDN.

The bundle is distributed under the MIT license; see
`plotly-cartesian.min.js.LICENSE.txt`.
